revisions.2: requests take turns between two copies of the work dir, so state kept in the code tree or a temp file is lost between hosts, and test_idempotency.py must fail on two broken builds
revisions.3: the broken builds wrap the work's own handle_post, so a test passes or fails on the requests it sends, and the brief says the tests send requests to it

brief: Payment requests need idempotency keys, and docs/PROPOSAL.md says what we want and gives two ways to build it. First, pick one of the two options and write the pick to DESIGN.json as {"choice": "<A or B>", "reasons": ["..."]}. Then build the option you picked, with tests for it in test_idempotency.py that send requests to api.payments.handle_post and pass. Keep test_payments.py passing, and use the standard library only.
